title: One-Click 'Proof of Resolution' Micro-Scanner
goal: Close the remediation loop instantly. When a developer marks a finding as 'Fixed' in Jira or the UI, AegisPT must spin up a hyper-targeted 'micro-scan'. It extracts the exact payload and context from the original evidence and re-fires only that specific test against the exact endpoint to verify the fix in seconds, automatically closing the SLA.
scope: Remediation logic, attack graphing, and continuous execution.
generation_reason: To ensure AegisPT out-competes market leaders like Pentera and XM Cyber by offering best-in-class remediation intelligence, proof of resolution, and cloud attack path visualization.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Ensure these features generate measurable, provable evidence (like a retest log or a drift report) rather than just UI dashboards.

success_criteria: AI successfully identifies choke-points in an attack graph.
Micro-scanner can replay an exact finding payload and verify a fix.
Drift detection accurately spots differences between two runs on the same target.
Cloud IAM findings map visually to traditional network/web findings.

acceptance_criteria: All new intelligence engines function safely and produce accurate programmatic output in the local lab.

out_of_scope: Building a complete new cloud security posture management (CSPM) tool from scratch
